source.title: Sonion Academy: Designing Earphones with Balanced Armature Receivers

provenance: Approximate digitisation of the two vector polylines in the single-driver example, not original measurement data. PDF plot quantisation and axis placement introduce uncertainty. Do not infer phase or source impedance from these points.
validation_status: FIT RESIDUALS: source fitted to these guide curves, not independently validated. Other damper positions are extrapolations.

configuration.normalization_or_fitting: Passive source parameters fitted jointly to damping change, undamped SPL and damped SPL at 8.25 mm; no gain fit or display smoothing. Unknown drive level limits absolute interpretation.
